attempts.sql: SELECT SPLIT_PART(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND SPLIT_PART(file_id, '/', 3) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SPLIT_PART(file_id, '/', 3) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query identifies immediate subfolders beneath auto_ontology/server/ by extracting the first directory level after the server prefix from each file's repository-relative path. It sums the total line_count for all Python files within each subfolder (including test files and __init__.py), then filters to only those subfolders exceeding 1,000 total lines. Results are ordered from highest to lowest total lines. Files located directly in auto_ontology/server/ (with no subfolder depth) are excluded from the grouping.
sql: SELECT SPLIT_PART(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND SPLIT_PART(file_id, '/', 3) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SPLIT_PART(file_id, '/', 3) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC
